remarks: Completely remodeled in 2023! Beautiful & desirable complex in a peaceful setting, yet only 1.4 miles to Downtown and 1.6 miles to the Stamford train station. Available for a August 1st. The interior has all the modern vibes you deserve! Engineered wood flooring throughout, an open floor plan, a focal wood-burning fireplace in the living room, plus private deck off the living room. The bedrooms are spacious and feature appealing vaulted ceilings. 2-year young washer & dryer are on 2nd floor. Pull down attic storage. Both full baths are gorgeous! Association allows 1 pet per unit (extra pet rent applies). Rent includes parking, grounds maintenance, trash pickup, water and sewer. Parking available for up to 2 cars (1 reserved & 1 guest spot)
